title: Vehicle Enhancement
strategy: Use Wrenches and Blueprints only at {{apo 08:00}} or {{apo 20:00}}! Also defeat Zombies only at {{apo 08:00}} or {{apo 20:00}}! This way, you'll earn points for your Full Preparedness event at the same time.
tip: Open Sunday's Radar chests now: points only count when you open the chests.

title: Shelter Construction
strategy: Complete your building upgrades and use Construction Speedups only at {{apo 08:00}} or {{apo 20:00}}! This way, you'll also earn points for your Full Preparedness event at the same time.

title: Technology Research
strategy: Complete your research and use Research Speedups only at {{apo 08:00}} or {{apo 20:00}}! This way, you'll also earn points for your Full Preparedness event at the same time.

title: Hero Development

tasks.name: Use Orange Equipment as Promotion Material

strategy: Today, only Advanced Recruitment counts for Alliance Duel and Full Preparedness. You don't have to worry about timing today. However, if you still want to do it, use Advanced Recruitment only at {{apo 08:00}} or {{apo 20:00}}.

title: Total Development
strategy: Today's point schedule: {{apo 00:00}} – Use Construction Speedups and increase your Building Power. | {{apo 08:00}} – Train Troops. | {{apo 12:00}} – Use Research Speedups and increase your Research Power. | {{apo 20:00}} – Train Troops again. | This way, you'll earn points for both Alliance Duel and Full Preparedness every time.
tip: Open Thursday's Radar chests now: points only count when you open the chests.

title: Enemy Elimination

tasks.name: Defeat Level 9 Soldiers (bonus points vs. enemy alliance)

strategy: Today, you can't combine Full Preparedness and Alliance Duel. Just complete your usual 3 chests throughout the day.
tip: Free server teleport to the opposing server, today only. The return trip lands randomly in your alliance hive, then a 20-second wait applies.
